description: Free, open-source, local alternative to ElevenLabs and Suno. AI sound effects, music with lyrics, text-to-speech and voice cloning on your own GPU (Stable Audio, ACE-Step and more). No account, no credits, offline. Windows/macOS app, HTTP API and a 21-tool MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor.
